system.longDesc:
Requirement: Fire Arcana (Expert)

Cost: 6 PP

Time: Major action

Target Number: 12

Test: None

You surround yourself with an aura of fire. Anyone you touch or who makes a melee attack against you takes 2 penetrating damage. Burning shield lasts for a number of minutes equal to your Willpower. You can renew the spell’s duration without another power test by spending its cost again before it expires.
